endpoint_url.title: Jeffrey MCP endpoint
endpoint_url.description: URL of the Microscope MCP endpoint. Keep the default for a Jeffrey on its usual port; change it for another port, a container or an SSH tunnel — it is the address Microscope serves on, with /api/mcp appended.

token.title: Jeffrey MCP token
token.description: Bearer token for a Jeffrey that sets jeffrey.microscope.mcp.token. Leave empty for a Jeffrey without one — it ignores the header. Sent as Authorization: Bearer on every request, and by the session-start check.
